title: System Administrator
description:
Hello! At **ESTECO** we are always seeking talented and motivated people who want to work with us. We are looking for a **System Administrator** to look after day-to-day IT operations in our **Pune** office.
  
  
You will be the local IT reference point for colleagues in India. You will handle first-level support on your own and work closely with our HQ IT team on the systems that are managed centrally.

This role suits someone with solid hands-on experience who wants to grow in an international environment. You'll follow established procedures, take ownership of your tasks and suggest improvements where you see them.

**Location:** Pune, India (on-site)

**Experience:** 2–3 years

**Employment type:** Full-time

### **What you will do**

**End-user support and assets** ‍

* Handle first-level support tickets on your own, from diagnosis to resolution.
* Configure and set up laptops, workstations and peripherals (hardware and software).
* Troubleshoot hardware issues and manage repairs with vendors.
* Keep the IT asset inventory accurate and up to date.

**Systems and infrastructure** ️

* Create and provision virtual machines, and troubleshoot VM issues.
* Manage user onboarding and offboarding, including account and access setup, together with the HQ IT team.
* Carry out patching and OS updates for clients and VMs, following central guidelines.
* Manage and renew CAD/CAE software licenses on the India servers.
* Support backup and recovery activities with the HQ team.
* Manage local network configuration and connectivity, and work with the HQ team on network changes.

**Vendors and procurement**

* Act as the local contact for hardware, software and internet service providers.
* Coordinate with vendors to resolve issues and escalate when needed.
* Manage AMC (Annual Maintenance Contracts) for hardware and software.
* Support hardware and software procurement in line with company processes.

**Ways of working**

* Track activities and progress in our ticketing system (Jira).
* Write clear, concise documentation for the procedures you follow.
* Communicate proactively with users and with the HQ team, for example by notifying users before planned maintenance and escalating critical issues promptly.
* Follow IT security and data protection policies when handling systems and sensitive information.

**Must have** ✔️

* 2–3 years of experience in a system administration or IT support role.
* Strong skills in configuring and troubleshooting Windows client devices.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory: user accounts, groups and permissions.
* Basic Linux administration skills.
* Hands-on experience with virtualization platforms (e.g., Proxmox, VMware, Hyper-V).
* Good understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPN and Wi-Fi.
* Experience with hardware troubleshooting and asset management.
* Experience working with vendors and service providers.
* Good written and spoken English, since you'll work daily with colleagues in Italy.

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to backup solutions, ideally Veeam / Proxmox Backup Server.
* Experience managing engineering software licenses (e.g., FlexLM / FlexNet license servers for CAD/CAE tools).
* Experience with ticketing tools such as Jira.
* A relevant certification (e.g., CompTIA, Microsoft, CCNA, VMware).

**Who you are** ‍

* Reliable and organised. You complete tasks accurately and on time.
* Calm under pressure, patient and empathetic with users who need help.
* Open to feedback and eager to learn from more experienced colleagues.
* Proactive: you ask questions, share what you learn and suggest small improvements.
* You understand that IT supports the business, and you prioritise with that in mind.

### **Perks and benefits**

* Flexible working-hours
* Remote working
* Travel opportunities: you will have the possibility to join our worldwide colleagues
* International experience
* Continuous growth and learning: you will constantly have access to internal soft skills and technical skills training, and also external events and industry conferences
* Friendly work environment
* Internal and external training
* Insurance
* Competitive salary

**About ESTECO**

ESTECO is an independent software provider that connects optimization, simulation, and business processes to enable smarter design of products and services. For nearly 30 years, the company has been pushing the boundaries of digital engineering to make complexity invisible and innovation effortless. Fueled by scientific research — its vendor-neutral, reliable technology serves over 400 organizations across automotive, aerospace, and manufacturing globally. Everyday, industry leaders like Ford, GE Aerospace, Toyota, and Whirlpool rely on ESTECO software to make data-driven decisions and achieve transformative results.

Take a look at our customers' success stories: https://engineering.esteco.com/ !

title: Operations Lead, Managed Services (MSP)
description:
Location: Pune Employment Type: full-time

### **Job Details**

**Position:** Operations Lead – Managed Services (MSP)

**Location:** Pune, India

**Experience:** 5–8 Years

**Reporting To:** MSP Practice Lead

**Team:** 24×7 Cloud Operations

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Role Overview**
-----------------

QloudX is looking for a technically strong and customer-focused **Operations Lead** to strengthen its AWS Managed Services (MSP) practice.

As our MSP business continues to grow, we are expanding our operational leadership capacity to support additional customer engagements, maintain service quality, and ensure scalable 24×7 operations.

The selected candidate will work alongside the existing Operations Lead, sharing responsibility for day-to-day operations, assigned customer accounts, team management, technical escalations, and continuous service improvement.

This is a **hands-on technical leadership role** requiring strong AWS infrastructure knowledge, operational discipline, customer-facing communication, and the ability to lead engineers in a fast-paced managed services environment.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing MSP customer operations while actively contributing to the growth and maturity of the practice.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. MSP Operations & Service Delivery**

* Take end-to-end operational ownership of assigned MSP customer accounts and service delivery activities.
* Collaborate with the existing Operations Lead to ensure seamless 24×7 operational coverage and clearly defined responsibilities.
* Manage daily operations, including incident, service request, problem, and change management in accordance with agreed SLAs.
* Oversee shift schedules, resource allocation, handovers, and on-call escalation arrangements.
* Ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests while maintaining customer satisfaction.
* Monitor operational KPIs, including SLA compliance, MTTA, MTTR, ticket backlog, and recurring incidents.
* Lead major incident management, including technical coordination, customer communication, RCA, and preventive actions.
* Maintain operational documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge repositories.
* Drive operational efficiency through automation, process improvements, and proactive monitoring.

### **2. Customer & Service Management**

* Act as the primary operational point of contact for assigned MSP customers.
* Build strong customer relationships through proactive communication and consistent service delivery.
* Conduct regular operational reviews covering SLA performance, incidents, security findings, cost optimization, and improvement initiatives.
* Manage customer escalations independently, ensuring timely communication and resolution.
* Coordinate onboarding and transition of new customers into MSP operations, including access management, monitoring setup, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer environments in terms of availability, performance, security, and cost.
* Collaborate with account management and practice leadership on service expansion opportunities.
* Ensure operational activities remain aligned with agreed SOWs, service boundaries, and customer commitments.

### **3. Technical Leadership & Escalation Management**

* Provide hands-on technical guidance to L1/L2 engineers for troubleshooting and incident resolution.
* Act as a technical escalation point for complex AWS infrastructure and operational issues.
* Troubleshoot issues across AWS compute, storage, networking, databases, security, and monitoring services.
* Coordinate complex technical escalations with L3 engineers, AWS Support, and third-party vendors.
* Review technical solutions, operational changes, and remediation plans to ensure reliability and security.
* Support AWS infrastructure optimization, including availability, performance, security, backup, and disaster recovery.
* Identify recurring technical issues and implement permanent fixes, automation, or preventive controls.
* Ensure production changes follow established change management and approval processes.

### **4. Team Leadership & Capability Development**

* Lead, mentor, and support cloud operations engineers across L1, L2, and L3 functions.
* Ensure adequate technical guidance and leadership availability across operational shifts.
* Conduct regular team reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and technical training.
* Review ticket quality, troubleshooting approaches, documentation, and customer communication.
* Identify skill gaps and develop training and AWS certification plans.
* Support hiring, technical interviews, onboarding, and performance evaluations.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, operational discipline, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Develop team capabilities to reduce dependency on senior engineers for routine operational activities.

### **5. MSP Practice Growth & Operational Scalability**

* Support the MSP Practice Head in scaling operations as new customer accounts are onboarded.
* Contribute to resource capacity planning, shift coverage models, and operational workload distribution.
* Help standardize processes, monitoring frameworks, runbooks, and service delivery practices across customer accounts.
* Identify automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reduce repetitive manual activities.
* Support operational readiness assessments for new customer engagements.
* Contribute to service quality improvements, operational reporting, and governance initiatives.
* Support AWS MSP program requirements, operational best practices, and compliance readiness.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

### **Technical Skills**

* **5–8 years of experience** in IT infrastructure, cloud operations, or managed services, including at least 4 years of hands-on AWS experience.
* Strong understanding of AWS services, including:
* **Compute:** EC2, Auto Scaling, Lambda
* **Networking:** VPC, Route 53, ELB, VPN, Security Groups, NACLs
* **Storage & Databases:** S3, EBS, RDS
* **Security & Identity:** IAM, CloudTrail, AWS Config
* **Monitoring & Operations:** CloudWatch, AWS Systems Manager, AWS Backup
* Strong Linux and Windows server administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Good understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPN, firewalls, and load balancing.
* Experience in monitoring, incident troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and production support.
* Practical knowledge of ITIL-based incident, change, problem, and service request management.
* Experience with ITSM tools such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with scripting and operational automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
* Understanding of AWS security, backup, disaster recovery, and operational best practices.

### **Leadership & Customer Management**

* Minimum **2 years of experience leading or co-leading** an IT operations, cloud support, or managed services team.
* Experience managing 24×7 support operations, shift planning, and technical escalations.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage customer accounts and operational commitments.
* Strong experience in SLA management, operational reporting, and service reviews.
* Ability to coordinate major incidents and communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and prioritization skills.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication.
* Ability to manage multiple customer environments and competing operational priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate, AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.
* AWS Professional-level certification is an advantage.
* ITIL Foundation certification.
* Experience working in an AWS Managed Services Provider environment.
* Exposure to AWS MSP program requirements and operational best practices.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
* Familiarity with container technologies such as Docker, ECS, and EKS.
* Knowledge of AWS security services, including Security Hub, GuardDuty, AWS Organizations, and Control Tower.
* Experience with AWS cost optimization using Cost Explorer, Budgets, Savings Plans, and Reserved Instances.
* Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance frameworks.
* Experience implementing operational automation, proactive monitoring, and self-healing infrastructure.

**Working Expectations**
------------------------

* Ability to work in a 24×7 managed services environment with responsibility for operational escalations.
* Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and provide occasional off-hours support for critical incidents.
* Comfortable handling multiple customer accounts and working with distributed teams.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and collaborate with peer operational leads.

title: Front Desk Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Position: Front Desk Executive

**Department:** Administration / Human Resources  
**Job Location:** Chinchwad, Pune, Maharashtra  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Admin Manager / HR Manager  
**Experience Required:** 0–1 Year  
**Qualification:** Any Graduate

1. Job Summary

We are looking for a professional, courteous, and well-organized **Front Desk Executive** to manage the reception area and provide administrative support to the organization. The candidate will be responsible for greeting visitors, handling incoming calls, managing visitor records, coordinating meetings, maintaining front office operations, and ensuring a positive first impression of the company.

The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, a pleasant personality, good telephone etiquette, proficiency in MS Office, and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently while maintaining professionalism and confidentiality.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Reception & Visitor Management

* Welcome and greet visitors, clients, customers, vendors, and business associates in a professional and courteous manner.
* Ensure that all visitors are attended to promptly and directed to the appropriate department or employee.
* Maintain visitor registers, visitor entry passes, appointment records, and other relevant documentation.
* Coordinate with concerned employees to confirm appointments and visitor meetings.
* Inform employees about visitor arrivals and ensure timely assistance.
* Manage visitor waiting areas and ensure that the reception area remains clean, organized, and presentable.
* Verify visitor details and follow company security procedures before granting access to office premises.
* Handle walk-in enquiries and provide basic information about the company, its services, and office departments.
* Ensure that visitors follow the organization's entry, safety, and security protocols.

B. Telephone & Communication Management

* Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and professionally.
* Transfer calls to the appropriate employees, departments, or extensions.
* Record and communicate messages accurately when employees are unavailable.
* Handle general enquiries and provide relevant information to callers.
* Maintain telephone directories, employee extension lists, and important contact details.
* Make outgoing calls for appointment confirmations, follow-ups, meeting coordination, and administrative requirements.
* Manage the reception email inbox, where assigned, and respond to routine enquiries.
* Ensure proper telephone etiquette and maintain a professional communication standard at all times.

C. Front Office Administration

* Manage the day-to-day operations of the reception and front office.
* Maintain front desk registers, appointment logs, courier records, visitor records, and other administrative documents.
* Receive, sort, record, and distribute incoming mail, courier packages, and official correspondence.
* Coordinate the dispatch of documents, parcels, and other company materials through courier services.
* Maintain records of incoming and outgoing couriers and obtain acknowledgements where required.
* Assist with printing, scanning, photocopying, filing, and document preparation.
* Maintain office stationery records and coordinate stationery requirements with the Administration team.
* Ensure the availability of visitor forms, office directories, company brochures, and other reception materials.
* Support the Admin and HR teams with routine documentation and office coordination activities.

D. Meeting & Conference Room Management

* Schedule and coordinate meeting room bookings as per employee requirements.
* Maintain meeting room calendars and avoid scheduling conflicts.
* Ensure meeting rooms are clean, organized, and ready before scheduled meetings.
* Coordinate seating arrangements, refreshments, and other meeting requirements.
* Inform relevant employees and visitors about meeting schedules and room allocations.
* Assist with arrangements for client meetings, interviews, vendor visits, and management meetings.
* Coordinate basic audio-visual equipment requirements and report technical issues to the concerned team.
* Ensure meeting rooms are properly arranged after meetings.

E. Coordination with HR & Administration

* Support the HR team in coordinating candidate visits, interview schedules, and interview room arrangements.
* Welcome candidates and inform the recruitment team or interview panel about their arrival.
* Assist with joining-day arrangements, employee ID coordination, and other administrative formalities as assigned.
* Coordinate with the Admin team for office maintenance, housekeeping, pantry services, and facility-related requirements.
* Report maintenance issues involving reception furniture, office equipment, lighting, air conditioning, or other facilities.
* Assist in coordinating employee events, celebrations, training sessions, and internal meetings.
* Support the distribution of internal communications, notices, and announcements.
* Coordinate with IT, Security, Housekeeping, and other support teams to ensure smooth office operations.

F. Courier, Mail & Document Management

* Receive and record incoming letters, parcels, courier items, and official documents.
* Ensure timely distribution of correspondence to the concerned employees or departments.
* Arrange outgoing courier services and maintain dispatch registers.
* Track important shipments and follow up on delivery status where required.
* Maintain records of document receipts, acknowledgements, and dispatch details.
* Ensure that confidential documents are handled securely and delivered only to authorized recipients.
* Coordinate the collection and dispatch of documents requiring signatures or approvals.

G. Office Appearance, Housekeeping & Facilities Coordination

* Ensure the reception area, waiting area, and meeting spaces remain clean and professionally maintained.
* Coordinate with housekeeping staff for daily cleaning and upkeep.
* Monitor the availability of drinking water, visitor refreshments, and other basic reception amenities.
* Check the condition of reception furniture, visitor seating, signage, and office displays.
* Report facility-related issues and follow up with the concerned department for resolution.
* Ensure that company brochures, displays, and other front office materials are updated and presentable.
* Support the maintenance of a welcoming and professional office environment.

H. Security, Confidentiality & Compliance

* Follow established visitor entry, identity verification, access control, and security procedures.
* Maintain accurate visitor logs and ensure that visitor passes are issued and collected according to company policy.
* Coordinate with security personnel for visitor clearance and employee access-related queries.
* Ensure confidential information, employee details, internal communications, and visitor records are protected.
* Avoid disclosing sensitive company information or employee contact details to unauthorized individuals.
* Immediately report suspicious activities, security concerns, unattended packages, or emergencies to the appropriate authority.
* Follow workplace safety procedures and support emergency response requirements as instructed.
* Maintain professional conduct and comply with company policies and administrative procedures.

I. General Administrative Support & Reporting

* Maintain daily visitor reports, call logs, courier registers, and meeting room utilization records.
* Prepare periodic front office and administrative reports as required.
* Maintain updated employee directories, contact lists, and departmental information.
* Assist with data entry, spreadsheet updates, document filing, and routine office correspondence.
* Monitor stationery and reception supplies and inform the Admin team when replenishment is required.
* Maintain proper records of administrative requests and follow up on pending tasks.
* Support internal audits and administrative documentation requirements.
* Perform additional front office and administrative responsibilities assigned by the reporting manager.

3. Required Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication skills in English and Hindi; knowledge of the local language is an advantage.
* Pleasant personality, professional appearance, and a customer-service-oriented attitude.
* Strong telephone etiquette and visitor-handling skills.
* Good interpersonal skills and the ability to interact with employees, clients, and visitors professionally.
* Basic to intermediate proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel, Outlook, and other office applications.
* Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and manage time effectively.
* Strong coordination and follow-up skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information responsibly.
* Problem-solving ability and a calm, professional approach to difficult situations.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with different departments.
* Punctuality, reliability, discipline, and a professional attitude.

4. Educational Qualifications & Experience

**Educational Qualification**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Diploma or certification in Office Administration, Front Office Management, Hospitality, or Business Administration is desirable.

**Experience**

* Typically 1–3 years of experience in front office, reception, customer service, or office administration.
* Fresh graduates with excellent communication and computer skills may also be considered.
* Experience in a corporate office, manufacturing company, service organization, or professional business environment is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Word and Excel.
* Familiarity with email communication, calendar management, and appointment scheduling.
* Knowledge of telephone systems, visitor management systems, and office equipment.
* Basic understanding of courier management, document control, and office administration.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Front Desk Executive will be evaluated based on the following parameters:

* **Visitor management:** Timely greeting, registration, and coordination of visitors.
* **Telephone handling:** Prompt call answering, accurate message recording, and efficient call transfers.
* **Professional conduct:** Maintenance of a courteous, helpful, and professional front office experience.
* **Record accuracy:** Accuracy and completeness of visitor logs, courier registers, and administrative records.
* **Meeting coordination:** Timely scheduling and readiness of meeting rooms.
* **Administrative efficiency:** Timely completion of front office and administrative tasks.
* **Communication effectiveness:** Accurate and timely communication with employees, visitors, and external parties.
* **Reception upkeep:** Maintenance of a clean, organized, and presentable reception area.
* **Confidentiality and security:** Compliance with visitor management, access control, and information security procedures.
* **Internal coordination:** Timely follow-up and resolution of administrative requests.

6. Key Working Relationships

* HR Manager / HR Executive
* Admin Manager / Administration Team
* Employees across all departments
* Senior Management
* Clients, customers, vendors, and business visitors
* Security personnel
* Housekeeping and facility management teams
* Courier and other service providers

7. Working Conditions

* Full-time, office-based position.
* Working hours will follow the organization's prescribed office schedule.
* The role requires regular interaction with visitors, employees, clients, and external service providers.
* May require additional support during client visits, recruitment drives, meetings, company events, and other important business activities.
* Requires adherence to professional dress standards, punctuality, confidentiality, and office discipline.

8. Overall Role Objective

To ensure the smooth functioning of the reception and front office by providing professional visitor management, effective communication, efficient administrative coordination, and a welcoming environment that reflects the company's professional image and standards.

**What you will be doing:**

* Provide and support engineering and process guidance, training and create documentation.
* Prepare and review engineering work products for technical documentation, quality, completeness.
* Resolve complex problems through the application of acquired technical experience and knowledge.
* Develop and communicate complex technical ideas and information in a concise and logical way.
* Creates and maintains the project/order-specific safety plan based on the safety life cycle with application-specific enhancements and/or tailoring.
* Plans and executes the assessment in all phases of the safety life cycle, taking the required level of independence into account.
* Is responsible for Safety Management Plan (SMP) and execution.
* Defines documentation structure and requirements on document quality.
* Specifies requirements pertaining to safety functions and their integrity.
* Tracks actions and, if necessary, triggers a return to a suitable point in the product life cycle and safety life cycle in the case of changes.
* Assesses the personnel resources used with regards to appropriate competence.
* Defines safety specifications for the use, integration, operation, and maintenance as well as decommissioning and disposal of the scope of delivery (customer documentation, customer training).
* Acts as an interface with approval authorities and safety monitoring bodies.
* Integrates suppliers and service providers into the product safety management system.
* Provides project coaching on all product safety topics.
* Prepares safety reports.
* Communicates the safety strategy within the project organization ("culture of safe working").
* Has an interface function with regards to functional safety officers of the customer and supplier.
* Executes, commissions, and evaluates reviews and audits on product safety in the project.
* Keeps proof of safety records for the project.
* Takes part in the preparation of declarations of incorporation if the EC Machinery Directive is applied.
